newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Quad Cities nuke seen up next week.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Quad Cities nuke seen up next week.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 789 megawatt Quad Cities nuclear power unit 1 will likely return to service early next week after being taken off line Friday for maintenance, a company spokesman said.
"Typically this type of work takes a couple of days, the unit should be back early next week," ComEd spokesman Gary Wald said Friday.
The unit, in Cordova, Ill., was being taken off line today for repairs to a feedwater control valve.
Six of ComEd's 12 nuclear power plants, including Quad Cities 1, are currently down for maintenance and refueling, and two more nuclear units are operating at reduced capacity.
The outages at the six nuclear units make a total loss of 5,814 megawatts (MW) generating capacity.
The 1,078 megawatt (MW) LaSalle unit 1 in Seneca, Ill., has been shut since September, 1996 for a maintenance outage and is tentatively scheduled to return to service in mid-April.
The adjoining 1,078 MW LaSalle unit 2 has been shut since September, 1996, for maintenance and refueling, with no restart date set.
The 789 MW Quad Cities 2 nuclear unit has been shut since March 1 for maintenance and refueling, and was expected to return to service in early May.
The 1,040 MW Zion 1 nuclear unit at Zion, Ill., has been shut since late February for repairs to a diesel generator, and is expected to return to service in early May.
The adjacent 1,040 MW Zion 2 nuclear unit has been shut since September for refueling and was expected to return to service in mid-April.

Also, the 1,105 MW Byron 2 nuclear unit was operating at 45 pecent of capacity as of early Friday during restart testing from a maintenance shutdown. The unit, in Byron, Ill., was expected to increase to full power over the next several days.
The 794 MW Dresden 3 nuclear unit was operating at 64 percent of capacity as of early Friday as it coasted down to a maintenance and refueling outage set to begin March 30 and last about 45 days.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
